subject: radiology
title: Post-TIPS encephalopathy and shunt tuning

steps.tx: Encephalopathy after a shunt follows ammonia that bypasses the liver and reaches the brain without detoxification. **Post TIPS encephalopathy** clouds attention and sleep within weeks as gut ammonia travels straight toward the brain. Constipation, infection, dehydration and sedatives stack together as **precipitants** that tip a fragile mind into confusion. **Lactulose with rifaximin** clears ammonia and quiets gut flora while the team removes each precipitant carefully. Driving and machinery pause until the mind clears, and the family learns relapse signs for home safety.
steps.say: Brain dysfunction after a shunt follows ammonia that bypasses the liver and reaches the brain directly. Confusion is common because it clouds attention and sleep as gut ammonia travels toward the brain. Constipation and infection and dehydration and sedatives are triggers and they stack together in a fragile mind. Gut drugs clear ammonia and quiet gut flora while the team removes each trigger carefully. Driving and machinery pause until the mind clears and the family learns relapse signs.

steps.tx: A narrowed shunt rescues the mind when drugs fail, because less portal blood then bypasses the liver. **Refractory encephalopathy** despite maximal drugs earns **shunt reduction** with an hourglass stent or constrained relining inside. Reduction raises the gradient again, so confusion relief trades against **re bleed risk** and needs honest consent. **Shunt occlusion** closes the channel fully as a last resort where mind matters more than pressure. Transplant review runs alongside every reduction because a failing liver underlies both confusion and pressure problems.
steps.say: A narrowed shunt rescues the mind when drugs fail because less portal blood then bypasses liver. Drug resistant confusion earns shunt reduction with a constrained stent placed inside the channel. Reduction raises the gradient again so confusion relief trades against bleeding risk afterwards. Full closure stays a last resort where mind matters more than pressure in decision making. Transplant review runs alongside every reduction because a failing liver underlies both problems.

steps.tx: This venogram shows an **hourglass constrained reduction stent** placed inside an existing shunt to narrow the channel deliberately. The waist limits portal bypass, so the **gradient rise** below the stent restores some liver perfusion after reduction. The labels link that narrowing toward **confusion relief**, because less ammonia reaches the brain once flow falls. The image matters for the exam because refractory encephalopathy despite drugs earns reduction rather than more lactulose alone. Consent still warns that pressure relief trades against a higher re bleeding risk afterwards.

steps.tx: Diversion can also push a marginal liver into failure, because portal flow no longer nourishes hepatocytes fully. **Post shunt liver failure** shows rising bilirubin with coagulopathy within weeks when reserve already runs marginal. **MELD tracking** after shunt creation catches deterioration early enough for transplant referral before irreversibility sets in. Nutrition continues with adequate **protein intake**, because starving brain and muscle worsens outcome after shunt surgery. **Early transplant referral** beats waiting for complete collapse when bilirubin climbs steadily after the procedure.

steps.tx: Follow up after a shunt never truly ends, because pressure, brain and liver change together over time. **Duplex surveillance** pairs shunt velocities against confusion episodes at every visit for that patient. Variceal bleeding and ascites watches continue because a reduced shunt raises pressure again in the portal system. **Medication review** stops sedatives and constipating drugs that quietly precipitate coma in a vulnerable patient. An **emergency plan** tells the family when drowsiness means hospital assessment rather than extra lactulose alone at home.
